source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC Web Security and access -> Sessions and check session information; source also asks to clear logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL with Redfish sessions and truncated ipmitool output; uses curl -k/password command-line patterns, suppresses parse errors and adds a disconnect boundary not requested by the source.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; complete protected Web/Redfish inventories, optional documented IPMI correlation, redaction and no-disconnect control.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Read-only intent is accepted, but `head` and jq error suppression prevent completeness, and its command omits the authoritative Web page evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassification and sensitive-data controls are accepted; the observer's own session and snapshot churn must be identified before field reconciliation.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or completed record; account or LDAP pages cannot substitute for live-session inventory.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Opening the Web view can create or refresh the observer session, so Web and API snapshots need bounded timestamps and a normalization rule for self-session and short-lived churn.

original_test_intent: Verify that the target BMC Web Sessions page reports the complete, owner-expected active session inventory and that supported API inventories reconcile without exposing or modifying session state.
original_method: Bind one BMC and observer identity; define expected session fields and redaction; capture the Web page and complete Redfish session collection within a bounded interval, optionally collect documented IPMI inventory, normalize only known self-session/churn differences and compare all fields while preserving audit logs and changing no session.
manual_activity: A security-authorized operator captures the BMC Web Sessions view and confirms expected users/sessions; automation collects complete protected API data and reconciles fields without disconnecting anyone.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC and observer account/session identity
Expected session policy and allowed active-session set
Required Web fields such as user, source, privilege and age
Supported Redfish SessionService collection URI and pagination behavior
Vendor-documented IPMI session semantics if used
Protected credentials and validated TLS policy
Redaction rules for usernames, IPs, session IDs, tokens and timestamps
safety_requirements: Keep the case read-only and never disconnect, revoke, reset or kill a session
Do not expose passwords, cookies, tokens or full session identifiers
Do not use curl -k or password command-line evidence without an approved bounded exception
Do not truncate inventory or suppress HTTP/parser errors
Identify the observer-created session and snapshot time
Stop on wrong manager, unsupported endpoint, secret exposure or uncontrolled churn
Do not clear audit, SEL or security logs
No automatic retry that creates additional untracked sessions
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete protected Redfish session collection with HTTP status and pagination
Optionally collect documented complete IPMI inventory
Redact and reconcile user/source/privilege/time fields under approved rules
Report mismatches without modifying sessions or assigning verdict
engineer_actions: Define expected session policy and field semantics
Authorize access to sensitive inventory and evidence storage
Investigate unauthorized or mismatched sessions and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Redfish URI is relevant, but TLS bypass, command-line secrets, suppressed errors and `head` make its evidence unsafe/incomplete; Web source-view coverage is missing and disconnect is outside scope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture the complete protected BMC Web and Redfish session inventories in a bounded window, optionally add full vendor-supported IPMI data, redact sensitive identifiers and reconcile every required field without disconnecting sessions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Sessions page information check and 10/10-minute estimates remain; no unrequested session termination or log clearing is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a redacted per-session matrix of source view, pseudonymous session identity, user/role, client category, creation/last activity, status and snapshot timestamp, plus documented self-session/churn differences.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing Web evidence, complete non-truncated collections, security handling and temporal correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Redfish and IPMI may expose different protocols or fields; neither automatically proves that the Web page renders the required complete information.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The inventory is time-sensitive and security-sensitive; sessions may appear/disappear between snapshots and raw identifiers can facilitate access analysis if leaked.

project_override_considerations: A Project may omit IPMI when unsupported, but must record that coverage difference. Any request to disconnect a session is a separate high-impact security operation requiring its own approval, target and recovery contract.
expected_evidence: Redacted BMC/observer identity, session policy, fields and snapshot window
Protected complete BMC Web Sessions capture
Complete Redfish collection with HTTP status, pagination and raw/parsed evidence
Optional documented full IPMI inventory and cross-source mapping
Audit/SEL evidence, no-disconnect and secret-handling audit plus engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define read-only session information inspection. DeepSeek's mention of disconnection is an execution boundary, not a competing source requirement.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sensitive read-only review is defined once the owner supplies session policy, supported endpoints, protected access and redaction rules.

review_improvement: Turns a truncated unsafe command into a complete time-bounded Web/API reconciliation with explicit self-session handling and no-disconnect proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Session inventory is a moving set, not a static configuration. The observation itself can create a session, so correctness must be evaluated against a timestamped allowed-session policy and stable field mapping rather than expecting byte-identical Web, Redfish and IPMI lists.
